name: com.maraudical.statuseffectsframework
description: A framework for implementing custom status effects.

samples.description: Add this sample first before adding any others. It mostly contains the necessary prefabs and base scripts for the other samples.
If you aren't using the Entities package you should download this sample.
If you aren't using the Entities package but are using UniTask you should download this sample.
Add this with the Shared Resources and Default samples if you are using the Netcode for GameObjects package.

If you are using the Entities package you should download this sample. Just note that there is an assembly defenition in the `Scripts/Define` folder just to use a netcode scripting define. You should remove or keep the associated preprocessing directives depending on if you are using Netcode for Entities or not.
Add this with the Shared Resources and Entities sample if you are using the Netcode for Entities package.
